summary: Iter 36 pre-redeploy e2e: backend 28/28 PASS (1 skipped public POST), frontend 9/10 PASS — only a horizontal-scroll regression at 390px on /admin. Admin login + Remember Me default-ON, PM login (Chris Wright lands at /pm with no must_change_password), PM forgot-password generic-success toast, Shop login, Issue-password modal renders all 4 footer buttons (Cancel / Show on screen / Download PDF / Email to PM) without overflow, Date Audit scan executes cleanly (Scanned 23 · Suspects 0 · Review 20 · OK 3 — 'No high-confidence Bug-2 victims found') and Review table renders 20 rows. PM scoping verified at API: PM list count <= admin list count for /inspections. Backend security check: /api/admin/date-audit and /apply both reject unauthenticated callers (401).

minor.issue: TEST_DATE_AUDIT smoke payload returned 4xx validation; unrelated to date fix — public inspection POST currently requires more fields than the smoke payload provided. Test was skipped, not failed.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal scroll on iPhone 390x844 — document.scrollWidth=570 vs clientWidth=390 (~180px overflow). Header action row 'MASCI HUB · Slow · PM Portal · Guide · Company Info · Sign Out' does not wrap on narrow viewports.

issues: Horizontal scroll + header overflow as above. iPad 768 and desktop 1440 are clean.

action_items: Make /admin header responsive at <=390px so it wraps or collapses (e.g. flex-wrap, hide labels, or move secondary buttons into a kebab menu). Currently producing ~180px horizontal scroll on iPhone.
critical_code_review_comments: formatDateLong fix (utils.js L51-71) — clean, regex-bounded, falls through to native Date for full ISO timestamps. LGTM.
DateAuditPanel POST /apply gated by AdminPasswordConfirm — verified admin-only at API (401 without token). LGTM.
Issue-password modal sm:max-w-2xl + flex-wrap renders 4 footer buttons cleanly at 1440. Did not regress at 768/390 in this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green, including new /api/admin/date-audit GET and /apply POST (admin-gated 401). PM forgot-password is enumeration-safe (200 for known and unknown emails). PM scoped lists return subset of admin list. Only known issue is /admin header horizontal-scroll at 390px — does NOT block redeploy, but should be fixed for mobile parity.
rca of the issue: Header on /admin uses a single non-wrapping flex row. At iPhone width (390px) the 5-6 action buttons exceed viewport, causing scrollWidth to grow to 570px. Fix: add flex-wrap or collapse to icon-only / kebab below sm breakpoint.
